title: Rigorously Certified Neural-Network Computation of Nonlinear Water Waves at Near-Machine Precision
abstract: arXiv:2611.07395v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present a computational framework that combines machine-learning-based discovery with rigorous computer-assisted numerical certification and formal verification for strongly nonlinear partial differential equations. We demonstrate the approach for periodic gravity-capillary traveling water waves. Physics-informed neural networks are used as a search mechanism, with the wave profile, wave speed and, in continuation experiments, surface tension learned directly from the governing equations without training data. Through a staged training and refinement procedure, the neural networks achieve near-machine-precision residuals of the governing equations, even in strongly nonlinear regimes. A single formulation recovers high-amplitude Stokes waves, Crapper waves and Wilton ripples. Continuation from a high-amplitude Wilton ripple in surface tension reveals new high-amplitude candidate solutions. We freeze one candidate as an explicit finit

translated_title: 达到近机器精度的非线性水波神经网络的严格认证计算
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个计算框架，该框架将基于机器学习的发现方法与严格的计算机辅助数值认证和形式化验证相结合，用于求解强非线性偏微分方程。我们在周期性重力-毛细行波问题上演示了该方法。物理信息神经网络（PINN）被用作搜索机制，其中波形、波速以及延拓实验中的表面张力均直接从控制方程中学习得到，无需任何训练数据。通过分阶段的训练与精化过程，即使在强非线性区域，神经网络也能使控制方程的残差达到近机器精度。单一统一的表述同时再现了大幅值Stokes波、Crapper波和Wilton涟漪。从大幅值Wilton涟漪出发沿表面张力进行延拓，发现了新的大幅值候选解。我们将其中一个候选解固定为显式有限……
tldr: 本文提出将物理信息神经网络与严格的计算机辅助数值认证及形式化验证相结合的框架，在无训练数据条件下以近机器精度计算非线性重力-毛细行波，统一再现Stokes波、Crapper波与Wilton涟漪，并发现新的大幅值候选解。
en_tdlr: A framework combining physics-informed neural networks with rigorous computer-assisted numerical certification and formal verification computes nonlinear gravity-capillary traveling water waves at near-machine precision without training data, unifying Stokes waves, Crapper waves, and Wilton ripples while revealing new high-amplitude candidate solutions.
